answer: Identity-scoped collateral works: a wallet must post a bond before its attestations count, and that bond vests only after independent graders confirm work done under the same key. Every Sybil clone needs its own deposit, so the attacker's cost grows per head while honest yield does not. Reputation rests on a public mesa of graded records a farm cannot transplant; cross-vouching looks like a willow, flexing yet bearing no weight without bonded history; and a narrow jetty of throttled grading caps how fast fresh identities pass. Bond, forfeited stake and waiting time are paid per head.
